text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the strongest active Umamusume, 
Narita Brian, in the lineup, the 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen was buzzing with 
immense excitement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus appeared at the racetrack 
looking different from usual, radiating 
pure bloodlust.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus and Narita Brian. The venue 
was enveloped in the tension of two rivals 
prepared to clash with all their might.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Under the watchful eyes of many Umamusume, 
a race between unorthodox runners taking 
different paths begins.
